200.description: The adoption for the effective range.

site_id.description: The site scope; omitted when the report covers every site.

days.description: One dense row per UTC calendar day intersecting the range, zeros included.

hints_issued.description: InterleavingHintIssued events that fell in the day's window.

hints_consumed.description: InterleavingHintConsumed events that fell in the day's window.

hints_expired.description: InterleavingHintExpired events that fell in the day's window.

adoption_rate.description: consumed / (consumed + expired) in the window; null while no hint ended.

consumed_first_rank.description: Consumed hints whose candidate was rank 1.

mean_detour_m.description: Mean detour in metres of the consumed candidates; null when none.

count.description: Hints consumed in the window whose issue the projection also saw.

p50_seconds.description: Median seconds from issue to consumption; null when count is 0.

p95_seconds.description: 95th percentile seconds from issue to consumption; null when count is 0.

400.description: `from` / `to` are not RFC 3339, empty or inverted, span more than 366 days, or `granularity` is not `day`.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: from and to must form a valid RFC 3339 range of at most 366 days
value.detail: from must be strictly before to

500.description: The analytical database query failed (ti-reports only).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem
